channel.title: Schuback.Tech Blog
channel.description: Essays by James Schuback on robotics, embodied AI, AI safety, and building AI systems for economic productivity.

item.title: Evaluating Safety Boundaries for LLM-Controlled Robotic Systems
item.description: A practical framework for evaluating task proposals, action authority, state freshness, containment, and recovery in language-controlled robot systems.

item.title: From Pixels to Physical Actions: The Interfaces That Make Embodied AI Work
item.description: What a plywood repair task reveals about calibration, uncertainty, perception, and the interfaces that connect a useful model to a dependable physical system.

item.title: AI Productivity Needs a Verification Loop
item.description: A source-backed look at AI productivity, with a worked engineering research workflow and a concrete way to account for verification, rework, and controlled release.

item.title: Adversarial Robustness & AI Control
item.description: Robustness, cybersecurity, loss of control, and human misuse are different problems. A broader look at how to bound autonomous agents and preserve meaningful human authority.
